search.question: RQ1: tests to failure, by search strategy

strategies.note: bracketed by exponential probe then bisected
coarse scan, bisection, then coordinate shrink

search.limitation: the oracle evaluates a single seed per point, so a counterexample found here is a property of that seed as well as of the condition. Reproducibility across seeds is RQ4, not this result, and a single-seed finding must not be reported as a regression without its reproduction rate.

reproducibility.interpretation: a rate well below 1.0 means the counterexample is a property of the discovery seed as much as of the condition. It must not be reported as a behavioural boundary without this number attached.

opposing_effect.criterion: per noise level: control delta >= +0.05 (budget >= 300) AND worst tight delta <= -0.10 (budget <= 112); strict sign inversion also recorded. REPRODUCED iff any noise level meets the margin criterion.
opposing_effect.detail: Opposing effect REPRODUCED at d7026af at noise level(s): 1 mm. Within those columns the candidate wins under the generous budget (control delta >= +0.05) and loses under a binding deadline (worst tight delta <= -0.10) -- a genuine sign reversal across channels.
opposing_effect.hypothesis_status: retired (original two-sided sign-flip hypothesis, current revision)
